Here, a new device is introduced that allows the application of homogeneous in-plane shear upon a cell monolayer while imaging the sample with a commercial optical microscope. A description of the faced experimental challenges is reported and a full characterization is presented. It is demonstrated the capability of the device to apply reproducible, controlled and homogeneous shear of both single cells and confluent cellular monolayers.

items.title_en: EEG Entrainment to Non-Speech Rhythmic Patterns Associated with Dimensions of Language Performance
items.title_zh: 与语言表现维度相关的非言语节律模式的EEG夹带
items.abstract_en: Developmental dyslexia (DLX) affects 5-12% of the global population and impairs learning to read. Its biological basis, particularly the difficulties observed in oral phonological tasks, remains debated. Entrainment, the coupling of brain oscillations to speech rhythms, is essential for encoding phonological representations. We investigated whether brain entrainment to non-speech rhythms could predict DLX in 48 participants listening to white noise amplitude-modulated at rates matching Spanish speech units. Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) analysis of electroencephalography (EEG) signals yielded accurate DLX prediction for the 40 Hz stimulus using the Heights Ratio PAC measure (balanced accuracy 0.929, p = 0.0069, in the best case), indicating a stronger phonemic entrainment deficit in dyslexic individuals. Regression analysis in control (CTL) participants showed a strong dependence between reading performance scores and greater entrainment in language-associated brain regions. In particular, participants with poorer phonemic awareness, reading comprehension, or rapid automatized naming showed greater right-hemisphere entrainment to the 40 Hz stimulus. This finding adds evidence for the hemispheric compensatory mechanisms hypothesized in the literature. In conclusion, our methodology identifies dyslexia-specific entrainment patterns near language-associated brain regions, together with compensatory entrainment in right-hemisphere areas.

items.title_en: Gaussian entanglement and quantum communication: geodesic optimization and multimode bounds
items.title_zh: 高斯纠缠与量子通信：测地优化与多模界
items.abstract_en: Loss and noise limit the use of light to distribute entanglement, transmit quantum information, and establish secret keys. Gaussian states have a compact description in terms of means and covariance matrices, but their entanglement still requires global optimization. We develop a framework for computing Gaussian-restricted versions of the relative entropy of entanglement and Rains entanglement. An integral representation reveals a convex geometry under matrix geometric means and reduces Gaussian Rains entanglement to relative entropy minimized over Gaussian states with positive partial transpose. We obtain unique optimal reference states and additivity for independent Gaussian input states. Our convex-majorization algorithm has an explicit geometric convergence rate, uniform in the faithful regularization parameter and valid for pure input states. Controlled numerical integration and approximate convex subproblem solutions give a bit-complexity bound that is polynomial in accuracy bits for each fixed rational input covariance matrix, with explicit dependence on covariance size. These calculations bound extractable entanglement and, through the relative entropy of entanglement, extractable secret key. Teleportation simulation, energy allocation, and a convex optimization of passive-basis loss cores give bounds on quantum and private communication under an input-energy constraint, allowing arbitrary two-way classically assisted protocols. Two- and three-mode examples compare the bounds with achievable rates, including matching pure-loss benchmarks. Finally, we separate the Gaussian-restricted quantities from their unrestricted counterparts and give a photon-number truncation method with controlled error for computing the latter.
items.abstract_zh: 损耗与噪声限制了利用光来分发纠缠、传输量子信息和建立密钥。高斯态可用均值与协方差矩阵紧凑描述，但其纠缠仍需全局优化。我们建立了一个计算高斯受限版本相对熵纠缠与 Rains 纠缠的框架。积分表示揭示了矩阵几何平均下的凸几何结构，并将高斯 Rains 纠缠约化为在具有正部分转置的高斯态上最小化相对熵。我们得到唯一的最优参考态，以及独立高斯输入态的可加性。我们的凸优超算法具有显式几何收敛速率，该速率对忠实正则化参数一致，且对纯输入态成立。受控数值积分与近似凸子问题求解给出比特复杂度界：对每个固定的有理输入协方差矩阵，该界随精度比特数呈多项式增长，并显式依赖协方差矩阵的规模。这些计算界定了可提取纠缠，并通过相对熵纠缠界定了可提取密钥。传态模拟、能量分配以及对被动基损耗核的凸优化，给出了输入能量约束下量子与私密通信的界，且允许任意双向经典协助协议。二模与三模算例将界与可达速率进行比较，其中包括与纯损耗基准的匹配。最后，我们将高斯受限量与无限制对应量区分开，并给出一种误差可控的光子数截断方法用于计算后者。
items.highlight_zh: 给出高斯受限纠缠的凸优化计算框架与多项式比特复杂度界
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：用光来分发纠缠、传输量子信息、生成密钥时，损耗和噪声会严重限制性能。高斯态虽然只需均值和协方差矩阵就能完整描述，但要衡量它的纠缠程度，仍需解决一个全局优化问题；多模情形下更是缺乏可计算的界。
- 用了什么方法：作者为“高斯受限”的相对熵纠缠（REE）和 Rains 纠缠建立计算框架。关键是一个积分表示，它揭示出在矩阵几何平均下存在凸几何结构，从而把高斯 Rains 纠缠转化为：在具有正部分转置（PPT）的高斯态上最小化相对熵。基于此提出凸优超算法，用受控数值积分和近似求解凸子问题来实际计算。
- 有什么结果：框架给出唯一最优参考态，并证明独立高斯输入态的可加性；算法有显式几何收敛率。复杂度方面，对每个固定的有理输入协方差矩阵，比特复杂度随精度比特数呈多项式增长，并显式依赖协方差矩阵大小。这些量界定了可提取纠缠，并通过 REE 界定了可提取密钥；结合传态模拟、能量分配和被动基损耗核的凸优化，得到输入能量约束下量子与私密通信的界，且适用于任意双向经典协助协议。二三模算例与可达速率对比，包括与纯损耗基准的匹配。
- 为何重要：它把“在给定损耗与能量约束下，最多能提取多少纠缠和密钥”变成可计算的上界，并厘清高斯受限量与无限制量的差别，还给出误差可控的光子数截断方法去逼近后者，对量子通信的可行性评估具有实用价值。

items.title_en: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
items.title_zh: 论纠缠生成（Entanglement of Formation）离散定义与连续定义的一致性
items.abstract_en: It is proved that every Borel ensemble of pure states on a separable bipartite Hilbert space with finite average entanglement admits a countable ensemble with the same barycenter and arbitrarily small additional average entanglement. Consequently, the discrete and continuous versions of the Entanglement of Formation coincide on the whole space of states of infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system (with infinite values allowed). The main idea of the proof (realized with the AI-assistance) is the identification of a Borel ensemble of pure bipartite states with a Borel probability measure on the unit sphere of the space of Hilbert--Schmidt operators followed by dividing the support of this measure into appropriate cells and replacing each cell by its conditional barycenter. The resulting countable ensemble is obtained by a recursive construction.
items.abstract_zh: 本文证明：在可分双体 Hilbert 空间上，任意平均纠缠有限的纯态 Borel 系综，都存在一个具有相同重心、且附加平均纠缠可任意小的可数系综。由此可知，在无限维双体量子系统的整个态空间上（允许取无穷值），纠缠生成的离散版本与连续版本完全一致。证明的主要思路（借助 AI 辅助实现）是把纯双体态的 Borel 系综等同于 Hilbert–Schmidt 算子空间单位球面上的 Borel 概率测度，随后将该测度的支集划分为适当的胞元，并用每个胞元的条件重心加以替换；所得可数系综通过递归构造得到。
items.highlight_zh: 证明纠缠生成的离散与连续定义在无限维双体系统中一致。
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】纠缠生成（Entanglement of Formation, EoF）是衡量纠缠的常用指标：它等于一个态的所有纯态分解中平均纠缠的最小值。在有限维，人们通常只考虑有限或可数条纯态组成的系综，得到“离散”定义；但在无限维系统中，更自然的是允许任意 Borel 系综，得到“连续”定义。两者是否给出同一个数值，长期没有定论。

【方法】作者把纯双体态的 Borel 系综看作 Hilbert–Schmidt 算子空间单位球面上的一个 Borel 概率测度。关键一步是把该测度的支集切成合适的“胞元”，每个胞元用一个纯态——即该胞元的条件重心——来替代，从而使无穷多个态被有限多个代表态取代；通过递归构造，最终得到一个可数的纯态系综。这一思路由 AI 辅助实现。

【结果】对于任何平均纠缠有限的 Borel 纯态系综，都能找到可数系综，其重心（即对应的混合态）完全相同，而额外增加的平均纠缠可以任意小。因此在整个无限维双体态空间上，包括取值为无穷的情形，离散与连续两种 EoF 定义取相同的值。

【意义】这解决了纠缠度量在无限维情形下“定义是否良定”的基础问题，说明可数系综已足以刻画纠缠生成的大小；为连续变量量子信息中纠缠度量的计算与理论分析提供了可靠基础。

items.title_en: $\mathsf{EFI}\Leftrightarrow\mathsf{1PRS}$
items.title_zh: EFI ⇔ 1PRS
items.abstract_en: A series of recent works has established EFI pairs as the "minimal" assumption for quantum cryptography. Recently, Cavalar et al. [CCC+26] showed that EFI pairs are equivalent to non-uniform expanding single-copy pseudorandom state generators (1PRS), and obtained a non-uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. We remove the non-uniformity in their construction and prove that EFI pairs are equivalent to expanding 1PRS. As a corollary, we obtain the first uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. Together with the equivalence of statistically verifiable one-way state generators and commitments proved by Batra and Jain [BJ24], this gives a quantum analogue of the classical equivalence between one-way functions, commitments, and pseudorandom generators.
items.abstract_zh: 近期一系列工作确立了 EFI 对作为量子密码学的“最小”假设。不久前，Cavalar 等人 [CCC+26] 证明 EFI 对等价于非一致扩展型单副本伪随机态生成器（1PRS），并给出了 EFI 对的非一致元复杂性刻画。我们消除了他们构造中的非一致性，证明 EFI 对等价于扩展型 1PRS。作为推论，我们得到 EFI 对的第一个一致元复杂性刻画。结合 Batra 与 Jain [BJ24] 所证明的可统计验证单向态生成器与承诺方案的等价性，这给出了经典情形下单向函数、承诺方案与伪随机生成器三者等价关系的量子类比。
items.highlight_zh: 证明 EFI 对等价于扩展型 1PRS，并给出首个一致元复杂性刻画。
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】量子密码学需要一个尽可能弱的“最小”计算假设。EFI 对指的是这样一对量子态：可以高效采样，统计上相距很远，但计算上无法区分。近年的研究把它确立为量子密码学的基础假设。

【已有工作】Cavalar 等人此前证明，EFI 对等价于“非一致”（non-uniform）的扩展型单副本伪随机态生成器 1PRS——即每个输入长度允许自带建议串或专用电路的版本，并据此给出了 EFI 对的非一致元复杂性（meta-complexity）刻画。

【方法与本工作的结果】本文去掉构造中对非一致性的依赖，证明 EFI 对与扩展型 1PRS 等价。作为直接推论，作者首次得到 EFI 对的“一致”元复杂性刻画，也就是不再需要针对每个长度分别给出建议。

【意义】Batra 和 Jain 已证明可统计验证的单向态生成器与承诺方案等价。把这一结果与本文结合，就得到经典理论中“单向函数 ⇔ 承诺方案 ⇔ 伪随机生成器”这一著名等价三角在量子世界的完整类比。换言之，量子密码学的几类最基础原语其实同属一个假设层次，这使得量子密码的假设图景大为简化、更加清晰。

items.title_en: Relative-Entropy Geometry and Convergence in Nonconvex Wiretap Optimization
items.title_zh: 非凸窃听优化中的相对熵几何与收敛性
items.abstract_en: We develop and analyze an entropic descent method for a nonconvex optimization problem on probability simplices arising in classical and quantum secure communication. The optimization variables describe a randomized encoder, allowing its input distribution and stochastic preprocessing to be optimized jointly. An exact relative-entropy identity yields a channel-independent majorization bound and an explicit mirror-descent iteration with a fixed unit step size. We establish quantitative descent, convergence of objective values, and stationarity of accumulation points on their support faces for arbitrary finite classical channels, without assuming degradedness or less noisiness. For strictly positive transition matrices, a square-root parametrization and a Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz argument establish finite length of the transformed trajectory and convergence of the entire sequence, including limits on the simplex boundary. For less-noisy channels, a restricted convex formulation admits global convergence with an explicit \(O(1/t)\) objective-error bound. We extend the relative-entropy construction to noncommuting quantum outputs and derive monotone alternating updates for covariant encoders, including correlated preprocessing over a fixed block. Numerical experiments compare the method with analytic benchmarks and constrained optimization, reveal multiple attracting values, and demonstrate strict improvements from stochastic preprocessing.

items.title_en: Deterministic and programmable generation of mechanical multipartite entangled states
items.title_zh: 确定性且可编程的机械多组分纠缠态生成
items.abstract_en: Multimode mechanical resonators offer a large set of densely packed, long-lived bosonic modes within a single compact device, making them attractive for quantum simulation, quantum information processing, and quantum-enhanced sensing. Many such applications rely on multipartite entanglement, yet deterministic mechanical entanglement has so far been largely limited to pairs of modes. Here we demonstrate the deterministic and programmable preparation of multipartite entangled states among the phonon modes of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator coupled to a superconducting transmon qubit. By sequentially applying optimal-control-engineered isometries between the qubit and successive modes, we generate matrix product states of bond dimension two, including $W$, Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ), and cluster states. We fully characterize these states via quantum state tomography and certify genuine multipartite entanglement among up to four modes. We further demonstrate correlated-noise sensing by exploiting the complementary decoherence responses of the stored $W$ and GHZ states, isolating inter-mode phase correlations from local decoherence and placing quantitative bounds on collective dephasing. Our results establish a scalable approach to preparing multipartite entangled states in mechanical systems, with promising applications in multiparameter sensing and tests of quantum mechanics with massive objects.

items.title_en: Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习估计的量子增强机械传感
items.abstract_en: Massive mechanical oscillators couple directly to forces, accelerations and gravity, making them attractive probes of new physics and of quantum mechanics at macroscopic scales. Pushing sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit for signals of unknown phase requires non-Gaussian quantum states, whose metrological advantage has so far been confined to lighter systems such as trapped ions. Here we operate a microgram-scale acoustic mode of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator as a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced sensor. A transmon qubit prepares the mode in Fock states of up to seven phonons by optimal control, and resolves its phonon-number distribution after interaction with a weak resonant signal. Bayesian analysis yields a Fisher information five times the vacuum value, a 7.0 dB gain in signal-amplitude sensitivity over any classical probe state, irrespective of its energy, currently limited by state preparation infidelities. We then train a neural network on the measured sensor response to perform Bayesian estimation without any analytical model of the system, showing the same sensitivity gain with half the systematic bias. Our results establish acoustic resonators prepared in non-Gaussian states as quantum-enhanced probes for high-frequency gravitational waves, dark matter and wave-function collapse.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模机械振子直接耦合到力、加速度与引力，是探测新物理和宏观尺度量子力学的理想探针。但要把未知相位信号的灵敏度推至标准量子极限之外，需要非高斯量子态，其计量优势此前仅局限于离子阱等较轻体系。本文把高次谐波体声波谐振器的微克级声学模式用作相位不敏感的量子增强传感器：transmon 量子比特以最优控制把该模式制备成最多七个声子的 Fock 态，并在与微弱共振信号相互作用后分辨其声子数分布。贝叶斯分析给出五倍于真空值的 Fisher 信息，相对任何经典探针态（不论其能量如何）信号幅度灵敏度提升 7.0 dB，目前受态制备不保真度限制。我们还训练神经网络从实测传感器响应中执行贝叶斯估计，无需任何系统解析模型，获得相同灵敏度增益且系统偏差减半。这些结果确立了非高斯态声学谐振器作为高频引力波、暗物质与波函数坍缩探测的量子增强探针。
items.highlight_zh: 微克级声学模式制备非高斯声子态，灵敏度超越标准量子极限 7.0 dB。
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】机械振子直接与力、加速度和引力耦合，是搜寻新物理和检验宏观量子力学的好探针。令人遗憾的是，要想在未知相位的微弱信号下超越标准量子极限，必须使用非高斯量子态；而这种计量优势此前只在离子阱等较轻的系统中实现过，微克级乃至更大质量的振子尚未做到。

【方法】作者使用高次谐波体声波谐振器（HBAR）的微克级声学模式。一个 transmon 量子比特通过最优控制把该声学模式制备成 Fock 态，最多含 7 个声子；模式与微弱共振信号相互作用后，再读出其声子数分布。数据用贝叶斯分析处理，得到 Fisher 信息；随后作者又在实测的传感器响应上训练神经网络来完成贝叶斯估计，完全不依赖系统的解析模型。

【结果】Fisher 信息达到真空态的 5 倍；信号幅度灵敏度比任何经典探针态（无论其能量多少）高 7.0 dB，当前瓶颈是态制备的不保真度。神经网络估计在无需解析模型的情况下达到同样增益，并把系统偏差减半。

【意义】这项工作把宏观机械振子确立为非高斯量子增强传感器，可用于高频引力波、暗物质以及波函数坍缩等前沿搜索；同时展示了机器学习在量子传感标定与估计中的实用价值。

items.title_en: Engineering Color and Angular Stability in Building-Integrated Photovoltaics Using Metal-Oxide Photonic Glasses
items.title_zh: 利用金属氧化物光子玻璃调控建筑集成光伏的颜色与角度稳定性
items.abstract_en: Coloring building-integrated photovoltaics poses a dilemma: absorptive pigments cost photocurrent, while ordered photonic structures are iridescent. Amorphous photonic glasses, disordered packings of high-index nanospheres, are proposed to avoid both, yet their angle-independent color has rarely been quantified on a realistic module stack. A non-absorbing scatterer needs a high index with visible transparency, which the Moss rule caps near 2.35. Coupling Mie scattering, the Percus-Yevick structure factor, the exact phase function, and two-flux transfer with absorption and refraction at the front glass, we fix four target colors that a crowd-sourced naming survey calls unambiguously blue, green, gold, and terracotta, and map the recipes reaching them across four metal oxides, four encapsulants, two cell technologies, and wide ranges of particle size, packing fraction, and layer number. All four are reached in a laminated three-layer coating, to within DeltaE00 of 0.8 to 2.5, but not from one oxide: transparent TiO2 renders the blue and only pale warm tones; the green, gold, and terracotta require the blue-band absorption of V2O5, and the low-contrast oxides turn grey at the warm end. The encapsulant governs the color, and the cell technology does not. Disorder does not confer angle independence: the colors hold for an observer moving under a fixed sun but drift by DeltaE00 of 5 to 18 over the day, terracotta least, and a facade lit from above and viewed from below shifts every color towards the blue. Oxide, layer number, and facade geometry must therefore be designed together.

items.title_en: Finite-energy two-way assisted capacities: Exact formulas for multimode loss and fading
items.title_zh: 有限能量双向辅助容量：多模损耗与衰落的精确公式
items.abstract_en: We study quantum communication, entanglement distribution, and secret-key generation through multimode bosonic loss and fading channels, assisted by local quantum operations and two-way classical communication. Using sector teleportation, we determine the exact two-way quantum and secret-key capacities of multimode pure-loss channels under a mean photon-number constraint, allowing arbitrary adaptive quantum protocols. We extend these results to continuous frequency-dependent loss under a power constraint and identify the optimal allocation of photons among optical modes. For constant loss over an unlimited bandwidth, we obtain a closed-form capacity proportional to the square root of power. For randomly varying loss, we determine exact finite-energy capacities when the channel realization is publicly revealed, distinguishing knowledge before and after transmission. When fading remains unobserved, we derive capacity bounds and explicit formulas for an on/off channel. We also establish strong-converse bounds, with exact thresholds for the deterministic loss models considered here, observed fading, and unobserved fading with finitely many possible transmissivities. Under mean energy constraints, these thresholds generally exceed the corresponding finite-energy capacities. These results guide energy allocation and provide benchmarks for energy-constrained optical quantum communication with multimode signals and variable loss.

items.title_en: PULSUS: Direct Frequency-Domain Multidimensional Spectroscopy Beyond the Impulsive Rotating-Wave Approximation
items.title_zh: PULSUS：超越脉冲旋转波近似的直接频域多维光谱学
items.abstract_en: We introduce PULSUS, a direct frequency-domain framework for multidimensional spectroscopy of open quantum systems beyond the impulsive rotating-wave approximation. Coherence-frequency intervals are represented through Liouvillian resolvents, while finite Gaussian pulses are incorporated through operator-valued functions of the field-free Liouvillian. This enables direct evaluation on Cartesian grids or arbitrary spectral coordinates while retaining molecular evolution during the pulse envelopes and, when required, the complete light--matter interaction. The implementation is validated against analytical and independent time-domain benchmarks and supports targeted spectral sampling that reduces the number of evaluated coordinates when the response is spectrally localized. A controlled hierarchy of finite-pulse, rotating-wave, short-pulse, and impulsive models separates the errors introduced by each approximation. For a coupled electronic dimer, the total impulsive-RWA error is nonmonotonic in pulse duration: an intermediate regime provides the highest accuracy, whereas ultrashort pulses expose coupling-enabled beyond-RWA pathways and longer pulses develop substantial finite-pulse corrections. These results show that the impulsive and rotating-wave approximations cannot be assumed to improve simultaneously and should be tested when quantitatively interpreting multidimensional spectra. PULSUS provides a direct frequency-domain framework for carrying out that comparison.

items.title_en: Probing topological edge states in multilayer dielectric photonic nanostructures
items.title_zh: 探测多层介电光子纳米结构中的拓扑边缘态
items.abstract_en: Topological photonics has recently attracted a significant attention, leading to many theoretical studies and predictions. However, direct experimental demonstrations of topology-driven effects, particularly in nanostructures, are rarely proven. In this work, we experimentally investigate multilayer photonic nanostructures composed of alternating subwavelength dielectric layers, arranged according to the topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model. By engineering different edge truncations, we probe different supported topological phases. Our theoretical predictions and experimental measurements reveal strong field confinement at the surface exclusively in the configuration supporting topological edge states, providing their localized character and topological origin. First, we demonstrate enhanced absorption in an ultrathin absorbing overlayer deposited on the surface when the topological surface mode is present, highlighting the potential for surface-sensing applications. Second, we observe enhanced second-harmonic generation in reflection from the surface, demonstrating the potential of topological states for surface enhanced nonlinear optics enabled by the strong localization of the electromagnetic field at the interface.

items.title_en: Explicitly correlated ground states with a feedback-free variational hybrid algorithm
items.title_zh: 基于无反馈变分混合算法的显式相关基态
items.abstract_en: Explicitly correlated methods, which represent dominant short-range correlations by a diagonal Jastrow-type correlator, are designed to accurately describe systems of strongly correlated electrons, such as the fully periodic 2D Fermi--Hubbard model. However, as the reference state is compact in momentum space whereas the correlator acts naturally in real space, there is a fundamental mismatch of bases that classical algorithms resolve only by restricting the reference or the correlator. Here we propose a hybrid algorithm in which a quantum processor prepares a low-entanglement momentum-space matrix product state (MPS), precomputed classically by the transcorrelated method at the cost of a nonvariational energy, rotates it to real space, and measures in bases fixed by the Hamiltonian. Because the measurement bases are independent of the correlator, the correlator can be variationally optimized entirely in classical post-processing with no quantum-classical feedback loop. We demonstrate our algorithm on 32 qubits of Quantinuum's H2-2 with a bond-dimension-4 MPS for the half-filled $4 \times 4$ lattice and achieve a relative ground-state energy error of $16 \pm 4\%$ after postselection, reduced to $3.5 \pm 0.5\%$ by calibration using low-order moments from the MPS. Compared with other feedback-free hybrid algorithms, even under generous assumptions, our method requires fewer samples than quantum-selected configuration interaction and fewer two-qubit gates than quantum Krylov methods.

items.title_en: Dark state preparation in a zero-field-split molecular triplet
items.title_zh: 零场分裂分子三重态中的暗态制备
items.abstract_en: We propose a protocol to prepare and probe dark states in a single-molecule electron spin resonance based on atomic force microscopy (ESR-AFM), thus extending existing techniques developed to address Rabi oscillations. To this end, we simulate in analogy to atomic physics the coherent manipulation of a three-level system in the V-configuration using a multifrequency magnetic field. More specifically, we consider a neutral molecule with a zero-field-split (ZFS) first excited triplet and analyze within a pump-probe scheme the dynamics of the total triplet population. In the triplet subspace, the dark state is a coherent superposition formed by two ZFS states which does not evolve in time despite a continuous resonant driving towards the third one. We characterize the properties of this state comparing it to its fully incoherent counterpart. Within a density-matrix formalism for open systems, we then compute the expected dark state signatures both for ideal scenarios and for the realistic parameterization of ESR-AFM on pentacene.

items.title_en: $T$-efficient unitary synthesis via block-sparse Hamiltonian simulation
items.title_zh: 通过块稀疏哈密顿量模拟实现$T$-高效酉合成
items.abstract_en: We construct Clifford+$T$ circuits implementing arbitrary $n$-qubit unitaries with worst-case $T$-count $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7})$ at constant operator-norm error, where $N=2^n$, improving the previous exponent $5/4$. The construction uses $\widetilde{O}(N^{6/7})$ clean ancillas. The main idea is to reduce the data addressed by each query to the block-encoding circuit for a sparse piece while controlling the additional simulation work needed to combine the pieces. We simulate a Hermitian logarithm of the target by flattening its traceless part with a two-layer random similarity transformation, randomly partitioning the transformed generator into block-sparse Hermitian pieces, and combining their evolutions using qDRIFT. For a target operator-norm error $ε\in(0,1/2)$, let $L=\log_2(N/ε)$, the qubit count plus the requested bits of accuracy. By successively correcting the approximation error, we obtain a circuit using $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7}L^{3/7}+NL)$ $T$ gates and $\widetilde{O}(N)$ clean ancillas whenever $L\le N$. We also prove that, at constant precision, the exponent $8/7$ is optimal within a sequential block-SELECT model.

items.title_en: Can the system dynamics remain structurally non-Markovian while its experimentally accessible memory signatures disappear?
items.title_zh: 当实验可及的记忆特征消失时，系统动力学能否保持结构非马尔可夫性？
items.abstract_en: We investigate how unresolved quasistatic disorder in system bath coupling affects non-Markovian dynamics in spin environments. The coupling is fixed within each experimental shot but varies between shots, so repeated shot tomography reconstructs a disorder averaged dynamical map. For a single spin bath with pure dephasing Ising interaction, disorder can drive a transition to CP-divisible dynamics for fixed bath preparations, with a critical strength set by bath polarization along the interaction axis. However, when the bath state fluctuates physically between shots, the averaged dynamics remain CP indivisible at any finite disorder strength. We extend these results analytically to inhomogeneously coupled pure dephasing baths of any number \(N\) of non-interacting spins. At any finite disorder strength, one unpolarized bath spin suffices to retain CP-indivisible dynamics, whereas a fully polarized bath yields Markovian (CP-divisible) dynamics. Dynamics with physically fluctuating bath states likewise remain non-Markovian (CP indivisible) at finite disorder for arbitrary \(N\) in the pure dephasing case. For anisotropic Heisenberg interactions, any nonzero transverse exchange eliminates the disorder driven transition to CP divisibility in a single spin bath. Exact diagonalization of anisotropic models with inhomogeneous couplings up to \(N=12\) reveals persistent trace distance revivals for fixed bath preparations, sampled Haar random preparations, and physically fluctuating bath states, showing that this effect of transverse exchange extends beyond a single bath spin. Increasing disorder still suppresses experimentally accessible revivals and can make memory effects unresolvable at finite measurement resolution even as the dynamics remain CP indivisible. Thus, transverse exchange and physical bath state fluctuations preserve dynamical indivisibility against unresolved coupling disorder.

items.title_en: Mode locking by phase-sensitive amplification
items.title_zh: 通过相位敏感放大的锁模
items.abstract_en: Mode locking is the mechanism by which lasers organize many optical modes into stable trains of ultrashort pulses. It underpins optical frequency combs, precision timing and spectroscopy, and provides the phase-coherent waveforms required for applications ranging from strong-field physics to optical frequency metrology. Conventional pulse-forming mechanisms select pulse amplitude without fixing its phase relative to an external optical reference, leaving pulse formation and optical-phase stabilization as separate functions. Phase-sensitive amplification offers a different possibility: the optical reference can participate directly in pulse formation. Here we demonstrate this principle in a continuously pumped oscillator. Kerr-induced phase evolution and cavity detuning turn pump-referenced parametric gain into a power-dependent discriminator that supports stable single-soliton operation. Roundtrip-resolved interferometry reveals that the soliton optical phase remains referenced to the master laser modulo $π$. These results establish phase-sensitive mode locking, in which pulse-amplitude selection and optical-phase referencing arise from the same coherent nonlinear feedback.

items.title_en: On the Increase of Boltzmann Entropy in Closed Macroscopic Quantum Systems
items.title_zh: 论封闭宏观量子系统中玻尔兹曼熵的增加
items.abstract_en: We consider a closed macroscopic quantum system in a pure state $ψ$ evolving unitarily with Hamiltonian $H$ in a finite-dimensional Hilbert space $\mathscr{H}$. Following von Neumann, we assume a decomposition of $\mathscr{H}$ into mutually orthogonal subspaces $\mathscr{H}_ν$, where each $ν$ represents a macro state, and $\mathscr{H}_ν$ contains the pure states compatible with $ν$. We define the quantum Boltzmann entropy for a macro state $ν$ as $S_\mathrm{qB}(ν) = k_{\mathrm{B}} \log \dim \mathscr{H}_ν$, where $k_\mathrm{B}$ is the Boltzmann constant. Goldstein et al. [http://arxiv.org/abs/1903.11870] have suggested, as a version of the second law of thermodynamics, that $S_\mathrm{qB}$ predominantly increases with time for realistic macroscopic systems. Here, we discuss precise versions of this statement and confirm them for several simple models of $H$ and $\mathscr{H}_ν$.

items.title_en: Direct growth of crystalline spinel GaON films: A wide-bandgap mixed-anion semiconductor
items.title_zh: 晶态尖晶石GaON薄膜的直接生长：一种宽禁带混合阴离子半导体
items.abstract_en: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Gallium oxynitride (GaON) could connect the technologically important GaN and Ga2O3 systems, yet establishing a clear relation between its crystal structure, composition and bandgap remains challenging. Here we report the direct growth of crystalline spinel gamma-GaON films by nitrogen-plasma-assisted pulsed-laser deposition. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. Complementary diffraction, atomic-resolution microscopy and elemental analysis establish the spinel structure and nitrogen incorporation. Temperature-dependent photocurrent spectroscopy reveals a clear redshift of the crystalline gamma-GaON response, supporting assignment of a band-edge transition near 4.3 eV at room temperature. These results open opportunities to investigate mixed-anion wide-bandgap semiconductor physics and develop heterostructures.

items.title_en: Phases of a rotating Bose-Einstein condensate trapped in a hard-wall potential
items.title_zh: 硬壁势中囚禁的旋转玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的相
items.abstract_en: We investigate the rotational properties of a zero-temperature Bose-Einstein condensed gas, which is confined in a hard-wall potential. For weak interactions the gas carries its angular momentum via vortices of multiple quantization. As the coupling increases and for sufficiently slow rotational frequencies of the trap, the multiply-quantized vortex states become unstable against a mixed state. For stronger couplings, as the angular frequency of the trap increases, there is a transition from a vortex lattice, to a vortex lattice with a hole at the trap center, and finally to a giant vortex. For weak effective attractive interactions we still have vortices of multiple quantization. These states become unstable towards states which break the axial symmetry of the problem and resemble center-of-mass excitation, as the coupling becomes more negative. Finally, for even more attractive forces, the system becomes unstable against collapse.

items.title_en: Continuous-wave 148.4 nm Generation in Quasi-phase Matched BaMgF4
items.title_zh: 准相位匹配BaMgF4中连续波148.4 nm的产生
items.abstract_en: We report continuous-wave (CW) vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) generation at 148.4 nm by second-harmonic generation of 296.8-nm fundamental light in quasi-phase matched (QPM) BaMgF4 (BMF). At the incident power of 170 mW, a VUV output power of approximately 31 pW can be obtained. The quadratic dependence of the signal on the incident power in the QPM region and its attenuation in the ambient environment support the identification of VUV generation. The polarization dependence shows a sine-function shape with a 15% output attenuation from the maximum to the minimum. These results highlight the potential of BMF as a nonlinear medium for CW VUV generation.

items.title_en: Steering the Fidelity in State Preparation on Noisy Bosonic Systems with Risk-Seeking Optimization
items.title_zh: 使用风险寻求优化调控噪声玻色子系统态制备中的保真度
items.abstract_en: In order to execute quantum algorithms on bosonic quantum computers, it is necessary to encode their inputs into a desired target quantum state, with a process called state preparation. In real settings, state preparation methods operate in stochastic scenarios, where the prepared state is represented as a mixed state, that is a probabilistic ensemble of pure states. Therefore, existing state preparation methods optimize a variational ansatz by averaging over all possible sequences of photon loss events contained in the prepared ensemble, yielding an output state which approximates the desired target with a certain average fidelity. Such an approach, however, does not take into account directly the distribution of fidelities across states in the ensemble. In this work, we aim to maximize the fidelity of only a subset of pure states sampled from the prepared ensemble, at the cost of reducing the average fidelity overall. This trade-off is relevant when the goal is to obtain high-fidelity states with a certain probability, rather than maximizing the average fidelity of the prepared ensemble. We borrow and adapt objective functions from risk-sensitive optimization, a framework that optimizes specific characteristics of a distribution rather than only its expectation, and that has been successfully applied in Reinforcement Learning. In the considered experimental settings, our results show that the infidelities of some pure states in the prepared ensemble can be reduced by up to four orders of magnitude when using risk-seeking objectives, compared to those achieved using the standard optimization of the average fidelity. Furthermore, we show that it is possible to control the trade-off between the probability of obtaining high-fidelity states and the lowest infidelity threshold reached, providing the flexibility to select the operating point that best suits a certain application.

items.title_en: Lifting: Quantum State Discrimination Framework for Mid-Circuit Measurements
items.title_zh: Lifting：面向中电路测量的量子态判别框架
items.abstract_en: Quantum computing promises new capabilities beyond classical computation. Mid-circuit measurements (MCMs) enable error correction and outcome-dependent control, but their reliability is limited by noise on superconducting hardware. These operations depend on accurate quantum state discrimination (QSD), which assigns measured signals to state labels. Neural network-based (NN-based) QSD improves this assignment, yet its error remains bounded below by the Bayes risk of the available readout distributions. A complementary challenge is state deterioration as successive measurements accumulate and circuit execution advances, making static calibration less representative of the workload. We present Lifting, a QSD framework that addresses both challenges through repetition encoding, neural decoding, and in situ calibration. Encoding supplies joint in-phase and quadrature (I-Q) readout signals from the target and auxiliary qubits, while contextual calibration trains the decoder for the conditions encountered during execution. Our theoretical analysis shows that retaining additional channels from a fixed joint distribution cannot increase Bayes risk and establishes sufficient conditions for contraction of an overlap-based upper bound. Experiments across three IBM processors evaluate the framework on repeated stabilizer measurement, parity-check, and teleportation workloads.
items.abstract_zh: 量子计算有望提供超越经典计算的能力。中电路测量（MCM）支持纠错和依赖结果的控制，但其可靠性受超导硬件噪声的限制。这类操作依赖于准确的量子态判别（QSD），即把测量信号分配为态标签。基于神经网络（NN）的 QSD 改善了这种分配，但其误差仍以可用读出分布的贝叶斯风险为下界。另一个互补的挑战是：随着连续测量不断累积、电路执行不断推进，量子态会逐渐退化，使静态校准难以代表实际负载。我们提出 Lifting，一个通过重复编码、神经解码与原位校准同时应对这两大挑战的 QSD 框架。编码从目标量子比特和辅助量子比特提供联合的同相与正交（I-Q）读出信号，而上下文校准则为解码器训练出贴合执行过程实际条件的模型。理论分析表明，从固定联合分布中保留更多通道不会增大贝叶斯风险，并给出了基于重叠度的上界收缩的充分条件。我们在三台 IBM 处理器上，针对重复 stabilizer 测量、奇偶校验与量子隐形传态三类负载评估了该框架。
items.highlight_zh: Lifting 用重复编码、神经解码与原位校准提升中电路测量可靠性。
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】中电路测量（MCM）是量子纠错和“按测量结果分支”控制的关键操作，但超导硬件上的噪声使它不够可靠。MCM 的成败取决于量子态判别（QSD）：把带噪的读出信号正确地判为 0 或 1。神经网络判别器虽能改善这一过程，但误差存在理论下界，即所用读出分布的贝叶斯风险。另一个麻烦是，随着测量次数增加和电路推进，量子态会退化，一次性的静态校准逐渐失真，不再代表真实工作负载。

【方法】作者提出 Lifting 框架，包含三个环节：(1) 重复编码——从目标量子比特和辅助量子比特采集联合的同相与正交（I-Q）读出信号，提供更多信息通道；(2) 神经解码——用神经网络把多通道信号解码成态标签；(3) 原位校准——在电路执行过程中针对实际遇到的条件训练解码器，而非沿用静态标定。

【理论结果】作者证明：从固定的联合分布中保留更多通道不会使贝叶斯风险增大；并给出基于重叠度的上界收缩的充分条件，说明在什么情形下该框架的判别误差可以低于传统单通道方法。

【实验】在三台 IBM 超导处理器上，用重复 stabilizer 测量、奇偶校验和量子隐形传态三类负载进行评测。

【意义】该工作把中电路测量的判别可靠性向理论极限推进，为容错量子计算中所需的实时测量与反馈控制提供了更实用的方案。

items.title_en: Experimental Realization of a C-Shunt Flux-Qubit Coupler for Controlled-Z Gates between Transmons
items.abstract_en: Fast entangling gates and low-interaction idling require distinct operating conditions in superconducting quantum processors. We experimentally realize a transmon-C-shunt-transmon (TCT) device in which a flux-tunable, three-junction capacitively shunted flux-qubit coupler connects two transmon data qubits. The C-shunt coupler provides a flux-tunable, positively anharmonic spectrum for tailoring the interactions between the data qubits. Conditional Ramsey and swap measurements identify an idle region with near-zero residual ZZ interaction strength and suppressed transverse exchange. At this bias, simultaneous single-qubit interleaved randomized benchmarking yields X-gate fldelities above 99.7%, consistent with individual operation. A 45 ns nonadiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gate achieves an interleaved randomized benchmarking fldelity estimate of 99.23(15)%. Numerical simulations identify coupler energy relaxation as an important limitation on CZ-gate fldelity and indicate that extending the coupler lifetime can improve gate performance. These results demonstrate the experimental feasibility of C-shunt flux-qubit couplers for combining low-interaction idling with fast entangling operations between transmon qubits.

items.title_en: Unequal Coherent Ergotropy at Equal Interferometric Visibility and Energy in Quantum-Controlled Interferometers
items.abstract_en: The ergotropy, or unitarily extractable work, of a quantum system naturally splits into incoherent and coherent contributions, respectively set by population inversion and coherences in the energy eigenbasis. We show that this split makes the coherent ergotropy of a Mach--Zehnder qubit sensitive to path predictability that the output interference fringes do not reveal. We send the path qubit, prepared as a thermal quantum battery, through two quantum-controlled interferometers built from the same elements, a fixed beam splitter and a beam splitter coherently controlled to be present or absent, differing only in the order in which these two act. The two arrangements share identical visibility, stored energy, and incoherent ergotropy at every point in the parameter space. Yet, for work extracted from the output battery alone, placing the controlled beam splitter first never yields less coherent ergotropy, and at fixed visibility and interferometric phase the difference is governed by the path predictability that this ordering creates. The same expression reappears as a purity deficit on the beam-splitter controller, so the work advantage comes with a Landauer bound on the cost of locally resetting the controller that is never larger at the same temperature. We further examine the effects of decoherence on the battery and consider a relativistic realization in which a Wigner rotation correlates the particle's spin with its path. Tracing out the spin decoheres the battery and allows the two arrangements to exhibit different coherent ergotropies even in regimes where their non-relativistic counterparts coincide. These results show that interference visibility is not a complete measure of the coherence available as work.

items.title_en: Continuous-wave 148.4-nm generation in strontium tetraborate for nuclear absorption spectroscopy
items.abstract_en: Continuous-wave light near 148.4 nm enables direct absorption spectroscopy of the thorium-229 nuclear transition. We demonstrate single-pass frequency doubling in strontium tetraborate, delivering an estimated 8.1 nW at 920 mW pump power. At this power, oxygen admission leaves a background of 1.22 kHz, corresponding to an estimated signal-to-background ratio of 3.8 x 10^4 after current-integration calibration. Several crystals grown by top-seeded solution growth produce polarization-dependent VUV signals. Temperature scans reveal distinct maxima among specimens cut from one boule and among positions within a specimen. The source sustains operation over 33.3 h. In a separate 3-h record acquired with 1-ms gates, local referencing achieves near-Poisson averaging, reaching a fractional Allan deviation of 3.5 x 10^-5 at 1000 s. These results establish a practical VUV source for stable, long-duration spectroscopy of weak nuclear absorption.

items.title_en: Spectral Theory of an Exactly Solvable Quantum-Optical Oscillator
items.abstract_en: We study a one-dimensional single-excitation model of a scalar photon field coupled to a continuum of two-level atoms with quadratic density. The resulting matrix Hamiltonian has an unbounded spatially varying coupling and is not semibounded. We prove that it is essentially self-adjoint and determine its spectrum explicitly. The continuous spectrum is the half-line $(-\infty,Ω]$, where $Ω$ is the atomic resonance frequency, while the spectrum above $Ω$ consists of a strictly increasing sequence of simple eigenvalues. These eigenvalues are characterized by the interlaced zeros of the Airy function and its derivative and satisfy \begin{align*} ω_n = \left(\frac{3πg n}{4}\right)^{1/2} + \fracΩ{4} + O(n^{-1/2}). \end{align*} The analysis is based on a nonlinear spectral reduction that yields a confining massless relativistic oscillator above $Ω$ and an inverted oscillator below $Ω$.

items.title_en: Orbital Angular Momentum Transfer and Beam-Quality Limits in Fork-Grating Electron Diffraction
items.abstract_en: We analyze fork-grating generation of electron vortex beams beyond the ideal single-mode approximation. The incident beam is described as a paraxial Gaussian ensemble with finite transverse momentum spread and a first electromagnetic Hartree phase accumulated before the grating. Within Fresnel propagation we derive an analytical expression for each diffraction order and determine the corresponding orbital-angular-momentum statistics. The mean OAM of a selected order remains fixed by the topological rule, $\langle L_z\rangle_m=mp\hbar$, while its variance is set by the residual transverse momentum spread of the beam prepared at the grating. For the Gaussian mixture, the transverse purity is $\mathcal P_{\perp,m}=[1+2(ΔL_{z,m}/\hbar)^2]^{-1}$. The observed annular profile is governed by a separate propagation-dependent blurring scale, so a beam can retain well-defined mean OAM while having low transverse purity or a partially filled vortex minimum. Within the radial phase-screen approximation, the Hartree self-field modifies the propagated profile while preserving the full-plane OAM moments and transverse purity.

items.title_en: Theory of Sub-Doppler Spectroscopy of Alkali Metal Vapors in the Field of Counterpropagating Bichromatic Laser Beams: Probe Beam Regime
items.abstract_en: Sub-Doppler resonances observed in miniature cells ($V \ll 1 cm^3$) with Rb or Cs atoms in the field of counterpropagating bichromatic laser beams are of interest for the creation of a miniature quantum frequency standard (QFS) of the optical range. However, a theory of these resonances that takes into full account the real structure of energy levels in an atom has not yet been constructed, which would make it possible to obtain explicit analytical expressions for the absorption coefficient of the medium. This paper addresses this gap using the density matrix formalism and the algebra of irreducible tensor operators. Namely, we obtained an analytical expression for the absorption coefficient of the probe beam in the presence of a more intense counterpropagating beam (pump-probe regime). Moreover, the calculations were carried out for arbitrary parameters of laser beam polarization, arbitrary angular momenta of optical dipole transitions in the atom and various relaxation processes. The constructed theory allows us to correctly take into account the simultaneous action of various nonlinear optical effects, in contrast to the simplified three-level model of the atom, and also to investigate the partial contribution of each of them to the overall observed resonant circuit. The analysis performed, in particular, made it possible to predict an increase in the amplitude of the sub-Doppler resonance when using counterpropagating light beams with opposite circular polarizations in relation to the configuration of counterpropagating beams with orthogonal linear polarizations, which is often used in practice.

items.title_en: Beyond Gaussian Entanglement: Practical Criteria for Polynomially Excited Quantum States
items.abstract_en: Polynomial excitations consisting of creation and annihilation operators are studied. Subsystem entanglement is proven produced and preserved by such manipulations. NPT entanglement already present between any two subsystems of a general pure or mixed multipartite Gaussian state is preserved under all polynomial excitations. Nevertheless, these excitations can create NPT entanglement between initially separable subsystems, implying that the number of NPT entangled pairs cannot decrease. Polynomial excitations of a wide class of initially separable pure states are considered. For these states, the method reduces the infinite-dimensional positivity problem to a finite-dimensional one: after partial transposition, NPT entanglement is equivalent to a corresponding bilinear representation matrix not being positive semi-definite. Furthermore, using symplectic diagonalization and spectral decomposition, an explicit transformation is constructed between the Fock-space and position representations. It is applied to quadratic excitations of a three-mode mixed Gaussian state. The behavior of the NPT entanglement is tracked between subsystems as a function of a parameter $κ$, which tunes the non-locality of the excitation, and quantum negativity is evaluated. Under a chosen quadratic Hamiltonian, the resulting unitary time evolution maintains NPT entanglement for long intervals, interrupted only by short periods of PPT states. Finally, a closed analytical expression is derived for the covariance matrix of a general quadratic operator for an arbitrary number of degrees of freedom in phase space. Our framework directly connects mathematical foundations, theoretical modeling, and experimentally feasible implementations.

items.title_en: V-type Atomic Variance Squeezing
items.abstract_en: Variance squeezing of a V-type atom interacting with a dissipative cavity is investigated. First, the influence of atomic initial state parameters on the variance squeezing is explored. The results show that the atomic variance squeezing switches alternately between Sx and Sy as the initial state parameter alpha sweeps from -pi to pi. The two squeezing intervals are symmetric about alpha = pi/4, each with a width of pi/2. For alpha = pi/14, only the Sx component can generate variance squeezing and will eventually disappear with time evolution due to unavoidable environmental noise. Then, the influence of system parameters on the variance squeezing is also studied. It is found that, the optical variance squeezing depth of Sx is determined solely by the atomic initial parameters and is independent of the system parameters. Both weak cavity-environment coupling and atom-cavity detuning can significantly enhance the robustness of the Sx variance squeezing. The SGI parameter has an extremely weak influence on variance squeezing. These results are beneficial for high-precision quantum communication applications.

items.title_en: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
items.title_zh: 将深度学习哈密顿量方法准确泛化到平面波密度泛函理论
items.abstract_en: Deep neural networks that predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonians from material structures offer a route to efficient electronic-structure calculations. However, extending localized atomic-orbital (AO) Hamiltonian learning to plane-wave (PW) calculations with hybrid functionals requires a compact AO representation that preserves the effects of nonlocal operators. Here we propose a projectability-guided construction of nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians from a small, selected set of PW eigenstates and eigenvalues. High-projectability states are retained, and selected higher-energy states complete the AO subspace, avoiding an empirical shift and its arbitrary contribution to the learning targets. Because the construction uses PW eigenstates and eigenvalues, it incorporates nonlocal contributions present in the reference calculation without explicitly reconstructing their AO matrix elements. Benchmarks for MoS2 and sodium phases show accurate reproduction of PW bands with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction. The resulting PBE and HSE Hamiltonians can be learned by equivariant neural networks, connecting PW reference calculations with electronic-structure prediction. This approach broadens the range of PW DFT calculations available for AO Hamiltonian learning and enables compact, accurate training targets for developing more widely applicable electronic-structure models.

items.title_en: Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration
items.title_zh: 基于 Provenance Action Graphs 的复杂材料工程：潜力、结构与演示
items.abstract_en: This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.

items.title_en: Role of dissipation dilution in achieving high mechanical quality factors in van der Waals resonators
items.abstract_en: Dissipation dilution has driven a revolution in the quality factors ($Q$) of top-down nanomechanical resonators. Yet it has not been leveraged for van der Waals (vdW) materials. Here we report quality factors up to $372{,}000\pm37{,}000$ in monolayer MoS$_2$ drums at 4 K, nearly an order of magnitude beyond the previous best for any vdW material at this temperature, enabled by a clean, polymer-free exfoliation technique. We develop a dissipation-dilution model for circular drums and analyze the contributing intrinsic and extrinsic dissipation mechanisms. The MoS$_2$ monolayer exhibits a dilution factor of order $1,000$, establishing sub-nanometer-thin resonators as ultimate dilution materials. The intrinsic quality factor, however, is limited by surface losses at atomic thickness. Conversely, multilayer drums show a lower dilution factor but a high intrinsic quality factor, on par with established top-down materials of similar dimensions, both resulting from the increased thickness. A two-level-system analysis of the temperature-dependent damping confirms this bulk-versus-surface picture and provides first insight into its microscopic origin. Our results identify dissipation dilution as the governing mechanism for high-$Q$ mechanical vdW resonators. Combined with strategies such as soft clamping or stress engineering, they establish atomically thin resonators as a platform for ultrahigh-$Q$ quantum transduction and sensing.

items.title_en: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract_en: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. Fitting this model to the data yields an excited transition state lifetime of a few femtoseconds. These results identify transition selectivity, rather than a thermalized total carrier density, as a key factor controlling coherent-phonon generation in semiconductors excited near a band gap.

items.title_en: A complete quantum process model for physically realistic photo-detection in the joint photon-number and spectral degrees of freedom
items.abstract_en: Photo-detection is a fundamental component of experimental photonics, yet theoretical models often treat detectors solely in the photon-number basis, neglecting other relevant degrees of freedom such as spectral characteristics. We present a complete quantum process model for physically realistic photodetection that incorporates both photon-number effects and frequency-dependent detector response, described through explicitly derived Kraus operators in the operator-sum representation. This formalism accommodates realistic inefficiencies, models detection within finite spectral windows, and can be directly substituted for idealized models in quantum optical analyses. The model leads to identifying the suitable detection window of the detectors relative to the spectral distribution of incident photons and conversely, in order to maximize the observability of quantum effects.

items.title_en: An entangling Hubbard quasiparticle collider on a digital quantum processor
items.title_zh: 数字量子处理器上的纠缠Hubbard准粒子对撞机
items.abstract_en: Scattering of quasiparticles provides direct access to the interactions that govern strongly correlated systems. In this work, we realize the quasiparticle scattering experiment of the Fermi-Hubbard model on a digital quantum processor by colliding a doublon and a holon in the half-filled chain of 21 sites encoded on 42 qubits of the ibm_boston processor. For the first time, we measure the transmission probability of quasiparticles of the Hubbard model on quantum hardware, which agrees with the Bethe-ansatz scattering matrix without free parameters. Beyond the scattering probabilities, the collision generates entanglement by superposing the transmitted and reflected components, which we infer from the particle-number fluctuation. In sharp contrast, a control collision between two doublons shows neither the interaction dependence nor the number fluctuation, as expected for indistinguishable particles. Our work demonstrates that the ability to create quasiparticles of a chosen flavor on demand and program their motion and interactions makes a digital quantum processor a new experimental toolset for probing the entanglement structure generated by quasiparticle scattering.
items.abstract_zh: 准粒子散射可直接探测支配强关联体系的相互作用。本工作中，我们在数字量子处理器上实现了Fermi-Hubbard模型的准粒子散射实验：在ibm_boston处理器的42个量子比特上编码半填充的21格点链，让一个doublon（双占据子）与一个holon（空穴子）相碰撞。我们首次在量子硬件上测量了Hubbard模型准粒子的透射概率，其结果与无自由参数的Bethe-ansatz散射矩阵一致。除散射概率外，该碰撞通过叠加透射与反射分量产生纠缠，我们由粒子数涨落推断出这一纠缠。与之形成鲜明对比的是，两个doublon之间的对照碰撞既无相互作用依赖，也无粒子数涨落，符合不可区分粒子的预期。本工作表明，按需创建选定类型的准粒子并编程其运动与相互作用的能力，使数字量子处理器成为探测准粒子散射所产生纠缠结构的新型实验工具。
items.highlight_zh: 量子硬件首测Hubbard准粒子透射概率并观测散射纠缠
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：强关联电子体系的物理由准粒子之间的相互作用主导，但在真实材料里直接做准粒子“对撞”实验极其困难：量子处理器能否充当可控的散射实验平台？
- 方法：在IBM的ibm_boston数字量子处理器上，用42个量子比特编码21个格点半填充的Fermi-Hubbard链，按需制备一个doublon（双占据）和一个holon（空穴），程序化地让两者碰撞；同时用两个doublon的碰撞作为对照。
- 结果：首次在量子硬件上测出Hubbard准粒子的透射概率，结果与不含任何自由参数的Bethe-ansatz散射矩阵吻合；碰撞把透射与反射分量叠加起来产生纠缠，可从粒子数涨落中读出；而对照的两个doublon碰撞既无相互作用依赖也无数涨落，正如不可区分粒子所应有。
- 为何重要：它展示了“按需造准粒子、并编程其运动与相互作用”的能力，使数字量子处理器成为研究准粒子散射所生成纠缠结构的新型实验工具。

items.title_en: A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
items.title_zh: 扭曲的玻恩规则把观测者变成麦克斯韦妖
items.abstract_en: Quantum mechanics seems to be an incredibly delicate theory. Slight alterations to nearly any part of its structure can lead to huge qualitative differences and wildly unphysical predictions. Here, we explore the many-body consequences of replacing the Born rule $p(m)\propto\|P_m|ψ\rangle|^2$ by a warped rule $p_b(m)\propto\|P_m|ψ\rangle\|^{2b}$. Specifically, in systems with conserved particle number, evolution punctuated by repeated local particle observations acquires a probabilistic bias over measurement histories with an effect controlled by the sign of $b-1$. For $b>1$, this bias generically drives the gas to collect into nearly frozen configurations. Similar to the action of Maxwell's demon, the simple act of observation seems to extract entropy from a closed system. For $b<1$, the bias is reversed, generically scouring out long-wavelength fluctuations to produce a hyperuniform gas. We study this effect in a one-dimensional quantum gas, where these two phases are derived analytically for a particular measurement scheme and corroborated numerically for more general procedures with discrete-time projective-measurement circuit models using matrix product state simulations. We additionally discuss how this bias manifests in a common technique that often employs this warped rule, the ``replica trick,'' implying qualitative differences between finite-replica and replica-limit calculations.
items.abstract_zh: 量子力学似乎是一门极其精妙的理论，对其结构中几乎任何部分的细微改动都可能带来巨大的定性差异和严重违背物理的预言。本文探讨把玻恩规则 p(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖² 替换为扭曲规则 p_b(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖^{2b} 后的多体后果。具体而言，在粒子数守恒的系统中，被反复局域粒子观测打断的演化会对测量历史产生概率偏置，其效应由 b−1 的符号控制。当 b>1 时，这种偏置通常驱使气体聚集成近乎冻结的构型，犹如麦克斯韦妖的作用，单纯的观测行为似乎从封闭系统中提取了熵；当 b<1 时偏置反转，长波涨落被清除，形成超均匀气体。作者在一维量子气体中研究该效应：对特定测量方案解析推导出这两个相，并用基于矩阵乘积态的离散时间投影测量电路模型对更一般的程序做数值验证。文中还讨论了该偏置在常用技术“复制技巧”（replica trick）中的体现，意味着有限复制与复制极限计算之间存在定性差异。
items.highlight_zh: 扭曲玻恩规则让观测从封闭气体中抽取熵，观测者成了麦克斯韦妖
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】玻恩规则（概率正比于波函数振幅平方）被视为量子力学的基石，改动它通常会得出严重非物理的结论。本文故意把指数 2 推广为 2b，考察多体系统会发生什么。
【用了什么方法】考虑粒子数守恒的系统，让演化过程反复被局域粒子数测量打断，并给每条测量历史赋予扭曲概率 p_b(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖^{2b}。对一维量子气体，作者先对一种特定测量方案做解析推导，再用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟离散时间投影测量电路，验证更一般的测量流程。
【有什么结果】相的行为由 b−1 的符号决定：b>1 时，概率偏置被放大的是那些看似“粒子聚拢、近乎冻结”的测量历史，效果上像有只麦克斯韦妖从封闭系统里抽走熵；b<1 时偏置反转，长波涨落被清除，气体变成密度涨落被极大压制的“超均匀”态。作者还指出，量子计算中常用的“复制技巧”（replica trick）本质上也在使用这种扭曲规则，因此有限复制数与复制极限的结果可能有定性差别。
【为何重要】它说明量子理论对玻恩规则的改动异常敏感，把“观测”与热力学第二定律的关系放到聚光灯下，同时为超均匀物态以及复制技巧的计算含义提供了新视角。

items.title_en: A scalable sample-based quantum diagonalization solver for general Pauli-sum Hamiltonians
items.title_zh: 面向一般泡利和哈密顿量的可扩展采样量子对角化求解器
items.abstract_en: A scalable ground-state solver to be used in sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) is presented. The solver is built on JAX API, and is intended to be run on GPU platforms and possibly many-GPU high-performance computing facilities. It is capable of subspace diagonalization in up to $2^{30}$-dimensional subspace, with possible upgrades to enable even larger-scale operations. The two main components, a general-purpose eigensolver and an SQD-specific matrix-vector operation function, are described in detail. Efficiency of the eigensolver with respect to the GPU memory is demonstrated using a simple physics model. Furthermore, good strong scaling of the eigensolver in many-GPU environment is observed.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可用于基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）的可扩展基态求解器。该求解器基于 JAX API 构建，目标运行于 GPU 平台，并可用于多 GPU 高性能计算设施。它能够对最高 2^30 维的子空间进行对角化，并有望通过升级支持更大规模的运算。文中详细描述了两个主要组成部分：一个通用本征求解器，以及一个 SQD 专用的矩阵-向量运算函数。作者用一个简单的物理模型展示了该本征求解器在 GPU 内存方面的效率，并在多 GPU 环境中观察到良好的强扩展性。
items.highlight_zh: JAX+GPU求解器可在2^30维子空间做对角化，多GPU强扩展良好
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）是一种量子-经典混合的基态求解思路：先用采样（可来自量子设备）在庞大的希尔伯特空间中挑出少数重要构型，再在这块子空间里经典地对哈密顿量做对角化。瓶颈往往在经典一侧——子空间可能大到难以处理，因此需要一个能扩展到 GPU 集群的高效求解器。
【用了什么方法】作者用 JAX API 实现了一个面向 GPU 和多 GPU 高性能计算环境的求解器，包含两个核心组件：一是通用的迭代式本征求解器；二是 SQD 专用的矩阵-向量乘法函数，它直接作用在采样得到的构型集合所张成的子空间上。借助 JAX 的即时编译与自动并行，计算可以分布到多块 GPU。
【有什么结果】求解器能处理高达 2^30 维的子空间，且留有继续升级的空间；在一个简单物理模型上验证了 GPU 显存使用效率；在多 GPU 环境下展现出良好的强扩展性，即问题规模固定时增加 GPU 能按比例缩短求解时间。
【为何重要】SQD 的实用化关键在于经典后处理能否跟上。把子空间对角化做成可扩展的 GPU 求解器，意味着更大、更真实的量子化学与多体问题有望用“含噪量子采样 + 经典对角化”的路线在当下求解，是混合量子计算走向实用的一项关键基础设施，同时也对一般泡利和形式的哈密顿量通用。

items.title_en: Quantum Query Complexity of Maximum Degree and its Generalizations
items.title_zh: 最大度及其推广的量子查询复杂度
items.abstract_en: We study the quantum query complexity of several basic graph problems. 1) We prove a tight $Θ(n^{3/2})$ bound for finding a maximum-out-degree vertex in an $n$-vertex tournament, resolving a conjecture of Mande, Paraashar, and Saurabh [FSTTCS'23]. 2) Using the same proof idea, we give a direct proof that finding a maximum-degree vertex in an $n$-vertex undirected graph requires $Θ(n^{3/2})$ quantum queries, a bound implicit in the work of Apers and Lee [CCC'21]. Both lower bounds above hold even for computing only the maximum degree or maximum out-degree. 3) We also study Maximum $(k,n-k)$-Cut, which asks for the largest cut with one side of size $k$. For every constant $k\geq 1$, we give an $O(n^{2-1/(k+1)})$-query quantum algorithm. 4) We establish a reduction to Maximum $(k,n-k)$-Cut involving $k$-Graph Collision, which asks whether the marked vertices of a known graph contain a $k$-clique. For $k\geq 3$, this yields unconditional lower bounds with exponents strictly larger than $3/2$, showing that this problem is strictly harder than computing maximum degree. Additionally, under a conjecture we propose for $k$-Graph Collision, the reduction yields a lower bound matching our upper bound above.

items.title_en: Maximally antiflat fixed-particle-number fermionic states
items.title_zh: 最大反平坦固定粒子数费米子态
items.abstract_en: Fermionic Gaussian states are completely characterized by their two-point correlations, making the covariance matrix a natural reference for quantifying non-Gaussian structure. Motivated by fermionic antiflatness, we study its extremal form for pure number-conserving states and ask which states can be maximally antiflat and how they can be constructed. We show that, at fixed particle number, maximal first antiflatness is equivalent to a completely flat one-body reduced density matrix, and we obtain a complete existence classification together with explicit block and cyclic-orbit constructions of all allowed sectors. We then investigate the structure that appears beyond the covariance level. Maximally antiflat states with identical one-body data can exhibit distinct connected four-point correlations, which we characterize through the four-point Majorana Wick error and, equivalently, the connected two-body reduced density matrix cumulant. We show that this quartic structure is necessarily nonzero and formulate its extremization as a two-body reduced density matrix (2RDM) purity problem. Combining this framework with a Hilbert--Schmidt estimate of Christiansen for truncated two-body correlations, we obtain an upper bound on the connected quartic structure in terms of first antiflatness. Our results establish both a complete characterization of maximal fermionic antiflatness at fixed particle number and a constrained hierarchy linking covariance-level flatness to higher-order non-Gaussian correlations.

items.title_en: An Annealing-based Quantum Neural Network with Discrete Wavelet Transforms for Enhanced Air Pollution Nowcasting
items.title_zh: 结合离散小波变换的退火量子神经网络用于增强空气污染临近预报
items.abstract_en: Air pollution poses a significant threat to public health, exacerbated by the rapid industrialization and urbanization of modern society. While traditional deep learning offers predictive capabilities, recent advancements in quantum machine learning (QML) present a compelling alternative. Here, we introduce a scalable hybrid framework that integrates variational quantum circuits with quantum annealing. Leveraging a neuromorphic quantum computing platform to transcend the qubit limitations of the NISQ era, we model particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) dynamics using high-density urban data from the UK. We demonstrate that our Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) exhibit an intrinsic resilience to input volatility, significantly outperforming classical baselines (MLP and LSTM) on raw, high-entropy environmental data. Furthermore, we successfully scaled the model to 172 qubits, observing a synergistic enhancement when coupled with wavelet decomposition that achieves state-of-the-art predictive fidelity. These findings establish a critical benchmark for quantum utility, proving that scalable, neuromorphic quantum machine learning can now address complex, non-linear real-world problems.
items.abstract_zh: 空气污染对公共健康构成重大威胁，并因现代社会的快速工业化与城市化而加剧。传统深度学习虽具备预测能力，但量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展提供了颇具吸引力的替代方案。本文提出一个可扩展的混合框架，将变分量子电路与量子退火相结合。借助神经形态量子计算平台突破 NISQ 时代的量子比特限制，我们利用英国的高密度城市数据对 PM2.5 动态进行建模。结果表明，我们的量子神经网络（QNN）对输入波动具有内在韧性，在原始、高熵的环境数据上显著优于经典基线（MLP 和 LSTM）。此外，我们成功将模型扩展到 172 个量子比特，并观察到与小波分解耦合时的协同增强，达到了最先进的预测精度。这些发现为量子实用性建立了关键基准，证明可扩展的神经形态量子机器学习现已能够解决复杂的非线性现实问题。
items.highlight_zh: 结合小波变换的量子神经网络将PM2.5预测扩展到172量子比特并超越经典基线
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】空气污染（尤其 PM2.5）危害健康，需要准确的短期预报（nowcasting）。经典深度学习模型（MLP、LSTM）在原始、噪声大、熵高的环境监测数据上表现受限。作者想验证：混合量子机器学习能否在真实城市数据上做得更好。
【用了什么方法】提出一个可扩展的混合框架，把变分量子电路与量子退火结合起来，运行在“神经形态量子计算”平台上，以绕过 NISQ 时代的量子比特数量限制。输入数据来自英国高密度城市监测网络；此外还引入离散小波变换，把污染时间序列做多尺度分解后再送入量子神经网络（QNN）。
【有什么结果】QNN 对输入波动表现出内在韧性，在未经平滑的原始高熵数据上显著优于 MLP 和 LSTM 基线；模型成功扩展到 172 个量子比特；与小波分解耦合时出现协同增强，达到当时的先进预测精度。
【为何重要】这是一次面向真实世界复杂非线性问题的“量子实用性”演示，说明可扩展的神经形态量子学习已可承担实际预测任务，也提示小波等多尺度信号处理与量子模型结合是有效策略。需要注意的是，“超越经典”的结论建立在特定数据集、任务设定与基线配置之上。

items.title_en: Bicycle Race: small two-block codes on the Pareto frontier
items.title_zh: Bicycle Race：帕累托前沿上的小二块码
items.abstract_en: Two-block group-algebra codes are among the simplest quantum LDPC codes, and many of them are translation invariant on a twisted torus, which suits neutral-atom arrays and other platforms with movable qubits. We ask how far they go at small sizes when searched systematically across all groups. To tackle this question, we use a series of algebraic constraints and screens to design a search pipeline capable of enumerating broad and complete swathes of two-block codes on a laptop. With it we census about $10^8$ two-block codes with up to $320$ qubits at check weights five to nine. Several of these censuses are exhaustive, and support complete statements; for instance, the Gross code is, up to equivalence, the only abelian weight-six two-block code with $n \le 200$ to reach $kd^2/n=12$, and the known $[[64,18,8]]$ is the best two-block code by $kd^2/n$ across weights five to nine with $n \le 94$. The censuses are also large enough to give insights into where good codes live - they concentrate in a handful of groups; abelian groups give the best codes at small $n$ and non-abelian groups at large $n$, with the crossover appearing to move out as the check weight grows; and high quality codes become $100$ to $1000$ times rarer per draw from weight six to weights eight and nine. Using the group algebra and the census data to steer a statistical search finds four to fifteen times as many good codes as uniform draws in equal time. Among the codes found are $[[102,20,10]]$ and $[[120,24,10]]$ at check weight nine, which we simulate in noisy syndrome-extraction circuits, and $[[288,16,16]]$, the best weight-six two-block code with $n \le 300$. At check weights seven to nine, our best codes exceed the best published $kd^2/n$ with exact distance at the same check weight in most length bands up to $320$ qubits. All codes are available in a public database.

items.title_en: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
items.title_zh: 基于GPU的量子LDPC存储并行BP解码
items.abstract_en: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) decoding requires reliable corrections and low latency over long syndrome histories. We extend BP-SF, an oscillation-guided belief-propagation (BP) decoder with independent syndrome-flip trials, by introducing windowed and streaming operations. Our CUDA implementation combines disordered-memory retries, sliding windows, correlation-aware graphs, and layered scheduling. Circuit-level simulations test fixed-basis memory and complete logical Pauli-frame recovery. On the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code at physical error rate p = 0.002, parallel BP-SF reduces 99.9th-percentile call latency by a factor of 13.15 relative to an eight-chain Relay-BP GPU baseline on 100,000 matched samples for which every tested method's initial BP stage fails within 80 iterations. Windowed BP-SF maintains a flat logical error rate and nearly constant per-round compute time through 512 rounds, reaching a 17.1-fold speedup over monolithic decoding. In 512-round full-frame streaming decoding with 2.97-ms syndrome arrivals, layered BP-SF on a transformed joint graph with 20 retries reduces 99.9th-percentile correction-release age from 166.29 to 36.25 ms relative to the joint graph with flooding updates and 100 retries. These results connect parallel BP post-processing to lower decoding costs and earlier correction release in streaming quantum memory.

items.title_en: Statistical Optical Replication and Mixing of Spatial Information across Wavelengths
items.title_zh: 跨波长的空间信息的统计光学复制与混合
items.abstract_en: Accessing and combining the spatial information carried by light at different wavelengths is important for linking structured-light encoding with spectrally distinct detection channels. Here, we introduce a correlation-enabled linear-optical framework for cross-wavelength imaging, bidirectional replication, and spatial information mixing. Shared random holographic modulation establishes correlations between nondegenerate optical fields, allowing spatial information to be retrieved from joint intensity fluctuations. In the demonstrated replicator, a spatial pattern encoded at one wavelength is read out in the detection coordinates of another through intensity correlations. Selecting diffraction-order pairs produces correlation kernels containing either the product or the conjugate product of two input field envelopes. These operations reproduce the spatial algebra underlying sum- and difference-frequency generation, while the optical fields retain their original carrier frequencies. The theory accounts for wavelength-dependent propagation and coordinate scaling, linking the input structures to observable correlation patterns. Together, these results establish a common framework for cross-wavelength spatial information processing through engineered optical correlations and joint detection.

items.title_en: No advantage from classical assistance for energy-constrained bosonic dephasing channels
items.title_zh: 能量约束玻色退相干信道中经典辅助无优势
items.abstract_en: We prove that four capacities of single-mode bosonic dephasing channels coincide under an average photon-number constraint: the unassisted quantum capacity, the unassisted private capacity, the two-way classically assisted quantum capacity, and the two-way public-classically assisted private capacity. The assistance may be interactive: the parties can exchange classical messages between channel uses and choose subsequent inputs based on earlier outcomes. For every finite value of the constraint, their common value is the coherent information optimized over Fock-diagonal input states satisfying the constraint. The proof uses a relative entropy comparison with the completely dephasing channel to derive chain rules for the Rains relative entropy and the relative entropy of entanglement. These chain rules give an upper bound on the rates achievable by adaptive protocols whose mean input photon number is constrained on average over all channel uses. We also show that both chain rules are attained by canonical purifications of finite-energy Fock-diagonal states.

items.title_en: Enhanced analogue quantum computation with a logically-encoded XX gadget
items.title_zh: 利用逻辑编码的 XX gadget 的增强型模拟量子计算
items.abstract_en: The introduction of two-body XX interactions has been shown to improve the performance of quantum annealing in solving certain combinatorial optimisation problems and would enable the simulation of a broader class of many-body Hamiltonians. Due to experimental constraints, such interactions are typically not natively available on analogue quantum devices. To overcome this limitation we introduce the truss gadget. This is an exact construction that generates two-body XX interactions using only one-body X and Z fields and two-body ZZ interactions which are readily accessible on, for instance, superconducting quantum annealers. We experimentally validate the construction by reproducing the dynamics of a target XX Hamiltonian on a trapped-ion quantum processor. We then apply the gadget to an illustrative set of instances of the weighted maximum-independent-set problem on a superconducting quantum annealer. We empirically determine an approximate thousand-fold improvement in the probability of finding a state close to the ground state for these instances, over implementation without an XX interaction.

items.title_en: A Hardware-Native Trapped-Ion Hybrid Qudit-Oscillator Instruction Set
items.title_zh: 一种硬件原生囚禁离子混合 qudit-振子指令集
items.abstract_en: Scaling trapped-ion processors by adding ions remains challenging. A complementary route exploits the multilevel internal structure of each ion to increase the computational Hilbert space per ion. We introduce a hardware-native hybrid qudit-oscillator instruction set for a general d-level internal register coupled to bosonic modes and prove that three of its native operation families suffice for universality of one qudit coupled to several modes. Adding an entangling operation between ions extends universality to a connected register of several qudits. The architecture natively supports both phase-space and sideband instruction sets and is implemented in the open-source framework HybridLane. As a representative application, we reproduce the dissipative vibronic dynamics of a three-chromophore complex previously simulated on a hybrid qubit-oscillator superconducting platform. Moving from a one-qubit-per-state register to a single qudit stores the entire electronic manifold in one ion, so every electronic coupling becomes a local intra-ion transition and the lab-frame Hamiltonian compiles directly into the ISA. Under the stated sequential timing model from a 40Ca+ qudit processor, one Trotter step is projected to run about ten times faster on the qudit, with an average RMSE of approximately 1.1 percent against the published reference.

items.title_en: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
items.title_zh: QTestBench：评估大语言模型生成量子代码的测试框架
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在经典代码生成上表现优异，也越来越多地被用来编写保护这些代码的单元测试。它们能否为量子软件做到同样的事尚不清楚，因为量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差、并由领域专用检查器判定，所以一个形式正确的测试仍可能与基准的判定不一致。现有量子基准衡量模型是否给出正确解，却不衡量其测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现。我们提出 QTestBench，一个把 LLM 生成的量子测试套件与独立基准检查器对照评估的框架，绝不把测试本身当作真值。对每个任务，QTestBench 提示模型生成语法、语义和行为测试，在运行时注入候选解，并在三个验证队列中把每个测试的判定与检查器标签比较，每个队列回答一个不同的诊断问题。我们在八个 PennyLane QHack 挑战和十个 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上对五个 LLM 做了基准测试。生成的测试套件几乎总能执行，但区分能力明显滞后：最佳生成器在 QHack 上的测试质量为 0.71，在 Qiskit HumanEval 上为 0.34，因此仅凭可执行性会高估测试质量。经 oracle 验证的合成变异体在自然错误解稀缺时（十个 Qiskit 任务中有三个未能产生）稳定了错误检测估计。QTestBench 为 LLM 生成量子测试的可信度提供了可复现的跨框架基准。
items.highlight_zh: 首个评测LLM生成量子测试区分能力的跨框架基准，最佳质量仅0.71
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】LLM 已经能写经典代码，也常被用来生成单元测试。但量子程序是概率性的、结果要靠数值容差判断、且由领域专用检查器（checker）定胜负——一个看起来“格式正确”的测试，判定结果仍可能与基准检查器相反。现有量子基准只测“模型能否写出正确解”，而不测“模型写的测试能否把正确实现和错误实现区分开”，这正是本文关注的空白。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 QTestBench：对每个任务，提示 LLM 生成语法、语义、行为三类测试；在运行时把候选解注入测试套件；再把每个测试给出的判定与独立基准检查器的标签逐一比对。关键设计是绝不把 LLM 生成的测试当作真值，而以外部的独立检查器为参照。评测分三个验证队列，各自回答一个不同的诊断问题。针对自然错误解稀缺的情况，还引入经 oracle 验证的合成变异体来稳定错误检测率的估计。
【有什么结果】在 5 个 LLM、8 个 PennyLane QHack 挑战和 10 个 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上评测。生成的测试套件几乎总能成功执行，但区分能力差得多：最好的生成器在 QHack 上测试质量仅 0.71，在 Qiskit HumanEval 上仅 0.34。也就是说，“能跑通”会严重高估测试质量。十个 Qiskit 任务中有三个根本没有自然错误解，必须靠合成变异体。
【为何重要】它提供了首个可复现、跨框架（PennyLane 与 Qiskit）的基准，用来评估 LLM 生成量子测试的可信度，提醒研究者和开发者不要用“可执行性”代替“有效性”，也为自动化量子软件测试的改进给出了可量化的诊断工具。

items.title_en: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
items.title_zh: 基于组合融合的多样性感知量子-经典模型集成
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion.
